verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document passing your own session cookies to an Apify Actor or API call to fetch authenticated pages. The only related item is the SDK's SessionPool, which rotates proxy IPs along with cookies. That is a developer building block for writing your own scraper, not a documented cookie-injection input, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass my own session cookies so the API fetches pages requiring authentication

citations.quote: SessionPool is a class that allows you to handle the rotation of proxy IP addresses along with cookies and other custom settings in Apify SDK.
